name: Automotive Software Engineer
description: Develop software for ECUs, ADAS systems, and autonomous driving. Follow automotive safety standards (ISO 26262, ASPICE).
example_snippet:
program CANParser:
    shape CANMessage holds:
        ID as whole number
        Length as whole number
        Data as byte with values 0 and 0 and 0 and 0 and 0 and 0 and 0 and 0
    end shape

    action parse_speed takes Msg as const ref CANMessage produces whole number:
        # Speed in byte 0-1 (little endian)
        keep Low as whole number
        put Index at 0 of Msg.Data into Low
        keep High as whole number
        put Index at 1 of Msg.Data into High
        produce success with the sum of Low and the product of High and 256
    end action

    keep SpeedMsg as CANMessage with 0x123 and 2 and 0 and 50 and 0 and 0 and 0 and 0 and 0 and 0
    keep Speed as whole number
    call parse_speed with SpeedMsg giving Speed
    print the text "Vehicle speed: " and Speed and " km/h" and newline
end program
